name: global-var-function-in-bala-test-943e6806ea/a-provider-v
reason: The provider initializes module byte arrays using base64 and base16 byte-array literals and exposes those values through getters. Byte-array literals are outside the explicitly supported literal forms, so the whole case requires an unsupported feature despite its otherwise supported globals, getters, setters and list/mapping constructors.
test_design_notes: The supplied provider has an empty main and no assertions; only its initialization and exported getter/setter behavior can be assessed from the allowed files.
